column2: This is version 20 of the Wireless Extensions. This is the

column1: completion of the RtNetlink work I started early 2004, it enables the
full Wireless Extension API over RtNetlink.

column2: o totally driver transparent, no change in drivers needed.
o iwevent were already RtNetlink based since they were created

column1: (around 2.5.7). This adds all the regular SET and GET requests over
RtNetlink, using the exact same mechanism and data format as iwevents.

column2: o This is a Kconfig option, as currently most people have no

column1: need for it. Surprisingly, patch is actually small and well

column2: o Tested on SMP, attention as been paid to make it 64 bits clean.
o Code do probably too many checks and could be further

column1: optimised, but better safe than sorry.

column2: o RtNetlink based version of the Wireless Tools available on

column1: my web page for people inclined to try out this stuff.

column2: I would also like to thank Alexey Kuznetsov for his helpful

column1: suggestions to make this patch better.
